Old_Rule: Explicit description or diagram of split procedure with train/validation/test roles and dates or ordering.
Signoff_Candidate_Rule: Published methods, supplementary methods, or verified code identifies the validation/splitting scheme and the role of development and evaluation partitions. Record the design subtype separately (chronological holdout; walk-forward; rolling; expanding; blocked; randomized; mixed; other). A split percentage alone may classify a holdout but cannot establish chronological order.
Reason: Clarification required for evidence-based adjudication; does not change Phase A records.

Old_Rule: Additional categorical detail stored separately: holdout, walk-forward, rolling, expanding, blocked, random, mixed; a percentage split alone is insufficient to establish chronology.
Signoff_Candidate_Rule: YES means the design was identifiable, not that it was leakage-free. TV02 addresses temporal ordering; TV03 addresses untouched testing; additional design subtype is mandatory for YES.
Reason: Clarification required for evidence-based adjudication; does not change Phase A records.

Old_Rule: Authors expressly state single fixed split only, or provide complete code with one evaluation and no reevaluation.
Signoff_Candidate_Rule: Direct statement that the study performed one fixed assessment only, or complete, verifiable implementation and results enumerating only one origin with no sequential reevaluation. Do not infer from one described fold when other experiments may exist.
Reason: Clarification required for evidence-based adjudication; does not change Phase A records.

Old_Rule: Explicit audited controls rule out the specific suspected mechanism; do NOT use to certify all possible risks absent.
Signoff_Candidate_Rule: Only for a separately named leakage mechanism, where a passage or complete verified implementation specifically excludes that mechanism. Do not record a global EXPLICIT_NO for PL09; absence of a discovered mechanism is not evidence of universal safety.
Reason: Clarification required for evidence-based adjudication; does not change Phase A records.

Old_Rule: Use separate mechanism tags; claim-specific EXPLICIT_NO is not overall Low risk.
Signoff_Candidate_Rule: Record one or more controlled mechanism labels (global scaling; full-dataset feature selection; random time split; overlapping outcomes; target look-ahead; textual timing; test-set tuning; future-aware imputation; full-period decomposition; other). Do not infer overall LOW from absence of PL09 YES.
Reason: Clarification required for evidence-based adjudication; does not change Phase A records.

Old_Rule: A separate risk judgment: HIGH only on verified material leakage; LOW only if key applicable information paths are positively shown protected.
Signoff_Candidate_Rule: Special ordinal judgment, not YES/NO. HIGH requires verified material forward-information contamination affecting a reported evaluation; LOW requires affirmative evidence that all materially applicable temporal, preprocessing, feature timing, and selection/test boundaries are protected in the assessed experiment; INDETERMINATE when evidence insufficient; CONFLICTED when sources disagree.
Reason: Clarification required for evidence-based adjudication; does not change Phase A records.

Old_Rule: Special allowed values HIGH, LOW, INDETERMINATE, CONFLICTED, NOT_APPLICABLE; preserve source evidence and avoid deriving LOW from absence of detected signals.
Signoff_Candidate_Rule: Document experiment-level evidence and protected/unknown/suspect pipeline boundaries. HIGH if a verified materially leaking experiment contributes to primary claims, with sensitivity for mixed studies. LOW cannot derive from no detected signals. Provide study-level aggregation decision.
Reason: Clarification required for evidence-based adjudication; does not change Phase A records.

Signoff_Candidate_Rule: Only when the record has no quantitative forecasting performance evaluation to benchmark; an empirical forecasting result without a baseline remains applicable.
Reason: Clarification required for evidence-based adjudication; does not change Phase A records.

Signoff_Candidate_Rule: No evaluated predictive method or forecasting comparison target; an empirical proposed model with no comparator remains applicable.
Reason: Clarification required for evidence-based adjudication; does not change Phase A records.

Signoff_Candidate_Rule: No quantitative claim of superiority or comparison among forecasting procedures, conditions or baselines; comparative claims without reported tests remain applicable.
Reason: Clarification required for evidence-based adjudication; does not change Phase A records.

Old_Rule: Study has no market decision claim and purely describes methods without forecasting.
Signoff_Candidate_Rule: Only when the study contains no empirical financial predictive evaluation or financial decision analysis. A forecasting paper that reports accuracy but no trading results is applicable, ordinarily NOT_REPORTED unless explicit absence is stated.
Reason: Clarification required for evidence-based adjudication; does not change Phase A records.

Old_Rule: Only gross metrics despite stated costs being excluded.
Signoff_Candidate_Rule: Direct statement or fully specified results showing only gross pre-cost performance or explicit omission of costs; lack of a net metric mention alone is NOT_REPORTED, not proof no net evaluation occurred.
Reason: Clarification required for evidence-based adjudication; does not change Phase A records.

Signoff_Candidate_Rule: No empirical predictive output evaluated. Point-prediction and deterministic models ARE applicable: lack of intervals or distributions cannot be converted into NOT_APPLICABLE.
Reason: Clarification required for evidence-based adjudication; does not change Phase A records.

Old_Rule: Working repository/archive with code linked to relevant study, version/commit or verified presence.
Signoff_Candidate_Rule: Repository/archive accessible at recorded check date and containing identifiable study-specific executable code (or archived runnable script) with source URL, path, version/hash and verification action; capture separate binary flags for LINK_REPORTED and ARTIFACT_VERIFIED.
Reason: Clarification required for evidence-based adjudication; does not change Phase A records.

Old_Rule: A URL printed in manuscript is not itself proof link works or contains experiment code; timestamp access check separately.
Signoff_Candidate_Rule: A repository URL alone does not establish working code or reproduce the paper. If once-public code is unavailable now, record access time and source conflict; never invent a commit.
Reason: Clarification required for evidence-based adjudication; does not change Phase A records.

Old_Rule: Specific downloadable dataset/repository or clearly stated public source and exact selection period/asset identities.
Signoff_Candidate_Rule: Source is retrievable or individually documented with sufficient dataset identity, sample period and assets to identify intended data; record separately DATA_LINK_ACTIVE and DATA_EXACT_RECONSTRUCTIBLE.
Reason: Clarification required for evidence-based adjudication; does not change Phase A records.

Old_Rule: Yahoo Finance mentioned generically is not complete reconstructibility.
Signoff_Candidate_Rule: A public dataset named without identifiers/dates is not proof of recoverable study data. Separate public availability from exact experimental reproducibility.
Reason: Clarification required for evidence-based adjudication; does not change Phase A records.
